args.body:
Summary of websites posted in #general:
1) www.informations.com: Latest job report brings mixed relief and concern as unemployment edged down to 7.2%.
2) www.restaurant-zurich.com: Zurich Restaurant is a cozy, alpine-inspired eatery in the city center serving authentic Swiss cuisine (cheese fondue, rösti, chocolate fondue), with warm wooden interiors, panoramic skyline views and staff in traditional Swiss attire.

Hi Dora! I visited your website. It's clean and simple, and having your contact email up front is handy. It could be improved with more content, such as a short bio, your projects or interests, and some visuals to give it more personality. Nice start!

Hi Eve! I enjoyed visiting your blog. Sharing your love of hiking gives it a personal touch. To make it better, you could add posts about specific trails, photos, tips and gear recommendations, and a clearer structure with categories. Looking forward to reading more!
